summary: Iteration 27 - Complete verification testing of Siempria Conteo (Conteo de Visitas) dashboard v5 redesign for Domingo Alonso Group. All backend APIs working (health, auth, ranking, cameras, users). All frontend flows verified: Login with admin/Conteo2024!, Dashboard with KPI cards, all 6 navigation tabs, NOC Competitivo embedded and fullscreen modes, User CRUD, Camera form modal, auto-refresh toggle, logout. No 'salidas/exits' text in UI - only 'visitas/entradas'. All logos (DAG, Siempria) displayed correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: App correctly uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from environment for API calls
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes
Spanish language UI throughout (Iniciar Sesion, Visitas Hoy, Camaras, Usuarios, etc.)
Premium light corporate theme for dashboard, dark theme for NOC Fullscreen mode
Empty states displayed when no camera data (expected - cameras on local network)
5 Canary Islands displayed: Tenerife, Gran Canaria, Lanzarote, Fuerteventura, La Palma
No 'salidas/exits' references in UI as required - only shows 'visitas/entradas'
User and Camera CRUD properly restricted to admin role
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - admin user auto-created on startup
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 27 verified the complete Siempria Conteo v5 redesign for Domingo Alonso Group automotive dealerships. All features working: (1) Login with admin/Conteo2024!, (2) Dashboard with 6 nav tabs, (3) KPI cards showing 0 visits/0 cameras (expected - no physical cameras), (4) NOC Competitivo with embedded view and fullscreen dark mode, (5) 5 Canary Islands displayed, (6) User CRUD (create, edit, toggle, delete), (7) Camera form modal, (8) Footer shows 'Domingo Alonso Group' + 'Desarrollado por Siempria | Tecnologia Mobotix', (9) NO 'salidas/exits' text anywhere - only 'visitas' shown. UI is light corporate theme, NOC fullscreen is dark theme.
